title: Fluid spacing with clamp()
summary: Padding and gaps that grow with the viewport between a minimum and a maximum, with no media queries.
explanation: Fixed spacing is either too roomy on a phone or too cramped on a desktop. clamp(16px, 5vw, 56px) means: 5% of the viewport width, but never less than 16px or more than 56px.
The section padding and the gap between cards both use clamp, so the whole page breathes more on wide screens and tightens on small ones, smoothly rather than in steps.
The same idea works for font sizes, as in the fluid heading example.
tryThis: Drag the preview edge from narrow to wide and watch the padding change.
Replace the padding with a fixed 56px and view it at 375.
Change 5vw to 10vw: it reaches the 56px maximum at a narrower width.
